title: Pete Sessions Alphabet and AbbVie Stock Sales: $15K–$50K Each (Sep 2026)
content:
Rep. Pete Sessions (TX-17) disclosed sales of $15,001–$50,000 each of Alphabet (GOOG) and AbbVie (ABBV) stock on September 18, 2026, both dated September 14.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

TickerCompanyType / sizePrice at sale vs. Oct 5 (Bargo est.)
GOOGAlphabet Inc. Class ASale, $15,001–$50,000$345.71 vs. $343.83 (−0.54%)
ABBVAbbVie Inc.Sale, $15,001–$50,000$261.77 vs. $265.76 (+1.52%)

Transaction date for both: Sep 14, 2026. Disclosure date: Sep 18, 2026 (4 days later). Member: Rep. Pete Sessions, TX-17 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Two sales: Alphabet and AbbVie, each $15,001–$50,000, on September 14.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Alphabet about 0.5% lower on October 5 than on the sale date and AbbVie about 1.5% higher.
  • Related filing: The same member's September 22 disclosure, a separate filing, is covered in our earlier post.

Quick FAQ

How long after the sales were they disclosed?
4 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 5 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
